'''Ewok-Basic pidgin''' was a combination language of [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]] and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] that the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] created after interacting with off-[[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]].
